questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: What is the genotypic ratio of the F₂ generation?
questions.explanation: The cross is Rr × Rr. It produces one RR, two Rr, and one rr offspring, giving the genotypic ratio 1 : 2 : 1.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The part labelled II is the
questions.explanation: Label II points to the thick-walled central organ of the female reproductive system. The uterus is where implantation occurs and the foetus develops during pregnancy.

questions.subject: Biology

questions.explanation: Label II points to the J-shaped muscular organ between the oesophagus and small intestine. The stomach mixes food with gastric juice during digestion.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The part labelled I is the
questions.explanation: Label I points to the snail’s large spiral outer covering. The shell is secreted by the mantle and protects the soft internal organs.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The part of the flower that is brightly coloured and attracts pollinating agents such as insects is labelled
questions.explanation: Brightly coloured petals attract insects and other pollinators to the flower. In the diagram, the petals are indicated by label IV.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The part labelled I is the
questions.explanation: Label I points to the large clear cavity in the cell. The vacuole stores cell sap and helps the cell maintain its internal pressure.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The type of teeth used for tearing in man is labelled
questions.explanation: Canines are pointed teeth used for gripping and tearing food. In the diagram, the canines are grouped under label II.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The endocrine gland that is located in the part labelled I is
questions.explanation: The pituitary gland is located at the base of the brain, corresponding to label I. It is often called the master gland because it regulates several other endocrine glands.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The structure labelled I is adapted for
questions.explanation: The long, sharp, slightly curved beak is adapted for boring into wood or bark to obtain insects. This feeding adaptation is represented by label I.
